attributes.name: Shadowcat
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to add your Wisdom or Survival skill to another character's combat check.

Discard this card to examine the top card of your location deck; if it is a non-villain, non-henchman monster and it does not have the Trigger trait, you may put it on the top or bottom of its deck, then you may explore your location.
